en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The most severely afflicted of the people are the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, then the successors<sup>as</sup>, then the next most favourable, and the next most favourable’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma’il from Fadl ibn Shadhan all from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rib’i ibn ‘Abd Allah from Fudayl ibn Yasar from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
People who are put to the most severe trials and sufferings are the prophets, then the successors of the prophets and then those similar to the last group in position and so forth.”
